content.title: Sport Qualia: Toward a Structural Approach to Subjective Sport Experience
content.abstract: Sport experience is rich in sensations that only the person feeling them can know: the feel of movement, the interaction with the environment, and the fatigue or pleasant mood that follows exercise.For the most part, sport science has measured the body objectively, building on physiology and physics.While subjective measures do abound in sport science, it is mostly as adjuncts to objective indices; the subjective experience of sport itself tends to be overlooked as an object of inquiry in its own right.Coaches and scientists often face a significant disconnect between objective data and an ath
